title: Ano ang Essential Loads?
premise: Essential loads are the must-run items during an outage (a few lights, internet, fridge); big loads like aircon drain a battery fast, so backup is usually a separate circuit.
scriptBasis: Claude draft from the episode plan (data/episodes.json) title/angle, V1.1 brand lines; claims checked online 2026-11-25.

sources: Sources: EnergySage critical load panels guide; Fronius & SMA
backup docs; U.S. DOE solar-plus-storage (checked 25 Nov 2026)

cues.text: Brownout na! Ano ang dapat manatiling bukas sa bahay mo?
Essential loads ang tawag sa mga gamit na pinaka-kailangan mo.
Kadalasan, ilang ilaw, Wi-Fi, at ref.
Ang malalaking load tulad ng aircon, mabilis umubos ng battery.
Kaya madalas, hiwalay na circuit ang ginagawa para sa backup.
Ilista muna ang gamit at ilang oras mo kailangan, bago pumili ng battery.
Dahil ang gusto ni Kuya SoLight… naka-solar ka na, SoSmart ka pa!

excerpts: Batteries can store solar energy produced during the day for use at night or during outages, if the system is designed for it.

sources.title: Critical load panels, explained
excerpts: Batteries are often wired to a separate critical loads subpanel.
Typical essential loads: refrigeration, lights, internet equipment, selected outlets; leaving out large air-conditioning/heating loads makes backup last longer.

sources.title: Backup power function
